platformTests.name: real main gateway and pinned DSH create a fresh main session and answer its first message
platformTests.reason: Adds a model through the real desktop host, which stores the key with Electron safeStorage. Headless Linux/macOS runners have no OS secret service (the host answers STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE), so this integration path is verified on Windows: the local vendor gate and the nightly regression run it. Follow-up: give the Linux vendor job a keyring so it runs there as well.
